newsitem.title: USA: Universal International in default on loan.
newsitem.headline: Universal International in default on loan.

text.p: Universal International Inc said Thursday it is in technical default of several provisions of its loan agreement with BankAmerica Business Credit Inc, a unit of BankAmerica Corp.

The company said it had been in the process of documenting a new loan at the end of last week, but failed to complete the agreement. Universal said it will now focus on securing a new line of credit within 90 days, but wil be forced to reduce its overall inventory in order to minimize the impact of the reduction of its current credit line.
Universal buys and sells close-out merchandise.
BankAmerica Business Credit is allowing Universal to remain in violation of the loan agreement until the company secures new financing, Universal said.

But the lender is also reducing the credit line to $12.5 million from $16 million and increasing the interest rate on the loan to prime plus three and a half percent from prime plus one and a half percent, Universal said.
The company said the loan agreement expires March 31 and is subject to monthly renewals unless it is terminated by either Universal of BankAmerica with ten-day written notice.
Universal said BankAmerica may also terminate the loan pact without notice if th company defaults on the loan.
Universal also warned there could be "a material adverse effect" if the company is not able to obtain financing from another lender within the next few months.
Universal shares closed down 7/16 Thursday at 1-11/16.
